title: toktier chunk-cut campaign: the rider document
description: Per-family sums of the rider arms of the chunk-cut campaign (tools/run_chunked_cut_campaign.py run --riders, summarize --riders-out), a separate document beside the chunked readings. riders names the arms every unit ran; each family carries one counter object per arm. special_tokens: documents encoded with add_special_tokens=True on the facade, compared with the oracle; served_by counts which counter of explain()["special_tokens"]["requests"] each call moved (facade, reference, or not_reported when the facade reported none); classes counts the post-processor class reported; vacuous counts the documents of an identity or prefix face that the reference answered. literal_segments: chat-shaped variants with the face's own added-token literals, encoded plainly; paths counts the path the last request reported (not_reported when none), bytes the segment bytes per engine. special_tokens also counts in executed_by the engine the last request's execution record names for each document (fast_cpu, gpu, hf, or not_reported). literal_segments paths are the routing paths, the span guard (hf_span_guard) among them under its own name. policy is the routing policy every unit was loaded under (null: the default). Checked by tools/check_reading_forms.py riders: mismatches, vacuous and not_reported are 0, every family ran every requested arm on at least one document, on an identity or prefix face at least half of the special_tokens core streams came from an accelerated engine, and the literal arm shows segmented documents with no document sent whole to the reference for a literal and reference paths (guards, the span guard among them) on at most 1% of its documents and 1% of its bytes.
